codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/schedules/delayed/%7BscheduleId%7D';
$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'AccountReference' => 'your-AccountReference-header-here',
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to cancel a message schedule in a single API call.
Before you start your implementation, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization
AccountReferenceStringYour Spryng account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000

Example request header:
DELETE https://api.spryng.nl/v2/schedules/delayed/{scheduleId}
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' 
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL0000000'

The Id of the schedule you'd like to cancel must be provided as a GUID within the path. Note: The scheduleId is different to the requestId or messageId. If requestId or messageId are provided, the request will fail. You can get a list of all of your scheduleIds using the GET v2/schedules/delayed endpoint.
